Title: [LSJ] Ivory Bow + Rötschreck vs Blood Rage

Messages.Author: Chris.QJ
Messages.Body:
hi,

in a recent game,in combat, Minion A announced his Ivory Bow as a
strike, and the opposing Minion B played Blood Rage.
can Rötschreck be played on Minion B?
i'm not sure but i ruled no, since in this case the Ivory Bow does no
damage, and Rötschreck can only be played if there is at least 1
point of agg damage.

???

regards
Chris.QJ

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris.QJ wrote:
> hi,
>
> in a recent game,in combat, Minion A announced his Ivory Bow as a
> strike, and the opposing Minion B played Blood Rage.
> can Rötschreck be played on Minion B?

Yes. A is attempting to do aggravated damage on B.

> i'm not sure but i ruled no, since in this case the Ivory Bow does no
> damage, and Rötschreck can only be played if there is at least 1
> point of agg damage.

Rötschreck is played before moving on to strike resolution.
Ivory Bow has been selected to strike for 1R agg damage.
